{{Quote|Better have my protocol droid standing by.''"<br />"''Your Brilliancy will recall that he was, ah, ''reassigned'' when his translation of your joke about the ''three Hardex'' and the ''bantha'' failed to amuse the Hardexian ambassador.|Craw and Steggus|<ref name="Droids 6" />}}
At some point, a [[Hardex]] '''ambassador''' visited [[Craw]], the self-titled [[Dictator-Forever]] of<ref name="Droids 6" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|219|Targonn}}</ref> [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]]. Craw told the Hardexian [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] a joke about three [[Hardex]] and a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]], though the latter was not amussed by a [[Craw's protocol droid|protocol droid's]] [[Translator/Legends|translation]] of the joke. As a result, Craw had the [[Protocol droid/Legends|droid]] deactivated and turned into a fountain.<ref name="Droids 6" /> In [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]],<ref name="Omnibus">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Droids]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Droids (1995)|''Star Wars: Droids'' (1995)]], which includes [[Droids (1995) 6|''Droids'' (1995) 6]], to [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]]. The [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] places the [[Hardex]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] meeting with [[Craw]] before the story's events.</ref> the Targonnian [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Steggus]] reminded Craw of the joke and the ambassador's reaction to it.<ref name="Droids 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ambassador was mentioned in the [[Droids (1995) 6|sixth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series [[Star Wars: Droids (1995)|''Star Wars: Droids'' (1995)]], which was written by [[Jan Strnad]] and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Droids 6" /> on [[October 31]], [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54170/star_wars_droids_1995_6|text=Star Wars: Droids (1995) #6}}</ref>
